BJP Leader Condemns Remarks Against Prophet Muhammad, Seeks Action

Sajid Shah, a leader from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), has condemned alleged remarks made against Prophet Muhammad. Shah has called for legal action to be taken regarding these comments. Separately, the BJP's Jammu and Kashmir unit is reportedly planning to file a complaint against Nazia Elahi Khan concerning remarks about the Prophet. An FIR has also been registered in connection with the alleged statements.
